description: Merge two or more PDFs into one, in the order given, and return the result. JPG and PNG images are accepted among the sources and each becomes one page the size of the image (pdf_image_to_pdf offers A4 or Letter pages, margins and more options); the type is read from the bytes. Sources are read only and never modified. Returns the merged PDF inline as an application/pdf resource. This tool only concatenates whole documents: it does not reorder, rotate or delete pages within them (pdf_extract_pages, pdf_rotate and pdf_delete_pages do), does not fill forms (pdf_fill does) and does not build documents from data (pdf_invoice does). An unreadable or rejected input fails with an error, so a partial merge is never returned.

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it). Applies to every input.

pdf_paths.description: In order, each a PDF or a JPG or PNG image source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… (or data:image/jpeg;base64,… / data:image/png;base64,…) URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths). An image becomes one page.

name: pdf_merge

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource

title: Merge PDFs
